verses.20:111: ۞وَعَنَتِ ٱلۡوُجُوهُ لِلۡحَيِّ ٱلۡقَيُّومِۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ حَمَلَ ظُلۡمࣰ ا

meaning: The root عنو (ʿanaw) primarily means to be lowly, humble, or submissive, especially to truth or God. It also describes becoming a captive or being confined.
